features.name: Research Lab Foundation
features.description: Scaffold a Research Lab (.agent/, research/, library/, literature/, experiments/, papers/, graph/, vault/, logs/, research-helper.yaml) with portable, workspace-relative paths and the global CLI entrypoint.
acceptance_criteria: init is idempotent
explicit-path init works
no absolute/OS-specific path is ever persisted
.agent/ has agents/, skills/, scripts/, schemas/, templates/, state/, adapters/

features.name: Research Task + State
features.description: Model a Research Task as an agent-independent unit of work with explicit status/step tracking, backed by .agent/state/{session,active-task,research-state}.json.
acceptance_criteria: task persists under .agent/state and reconstructs after a fresh process
agent_history accumulates every agent that touched the task

features.name: Scientific Search
features.description: literature-search skill: structured search across Semantic Scholar/Crossref/OpenAlex, normalized schema, dedup by DOI/title/authors+year, reproducible search manifest.
acceptance_criteria: search --format json returns deduplicated schema-conformant results
search manifest written and re-executable
network calls go through mockable client adapters

features.name: Paper Import
features.description: Import a PDF (or metadata-only record) into library/papers/<doi-or-hash>/ with provenance (source, original_url, doi, retrieved_at, sha256, license, open_access).
acceptance_criteria: import creates identifier dir with sha256 provenance
re-import of identical file is detected, not duplicated
import without DOI falls back to hash id

features.name: Reference Extraction
features.description: reference-harvester (extraction half): PDF -> references.raw.json / references.normalized.json via text/structured extraction, reference-section detection, parsing, DOI extraction.
acceptance_criteria: extract reports discovered-reference count
deterministic given the same PDF, no LLM call needed
output validates against reference schema

features.name: Reference Resolution
features.description: Resolve raw references to real external documents (references.resolved.json) with states RESOLVED/VERIFIED/AMBIGUOUS/UNAVAILABLE/INVALID, flagging bibliographic-consistency mismatches, never trusting the citing paper alone.
acceptance_criteria: resolve reports verified/ambiguous/unavailable/unresolved counts
year/author mismatch surfaced as flagged inconsistency
references.bib emitted alongside JSON

features.name: Open Access Acquisition
features.description: Download resolved references only when legally available, recording METADATA_ONLY/PAYWALLED otherwise, with .cache/ to avoid redundant external calls.
acceptance_criteria: download only writes PDFs for OA-available refs; others get PAYWALLED/METADATA_ONLY and stay in the graph
repeated download call is a cache hit

features.name: Structured Paper Synthesis
features.description: paper-synthesizer skill: full structured synthesis schema per paper plus comparison/disagreements/common-findings/research-gaps across papers.
acceptance_criteria: summarize produces every schema section, marking unsupported sections as Not defined by current context, never fabricated
comparative synthesis across >=2 papers produces all four cross-paper artifacts

features.name: Citation Validation
features.description: citation-validator skill: three-level evaluation (Existence, Bibliographic Consistency, Claim Support) with stored evidence, justification, and confidence; UNVERIFIED precedes SUSPECTED_INVALID.
acceptance_criteria: citations validate emits Level 1/2/3 result per citation with evidence+confidence
no citation is SUSPECTED_INVALID without first passing through UNVERIFIED

features.name: Graphify Integration
features.description: Build a file-based, Graphify-compatible citation graph (CITES and the full §13 node/relation vocabulary) derived from resolved references, no hand-maintained graph state.
acceptance_criteria: graph build is idempotent/re-runnable from the same library
seminal-paper / isolated-claim style queries answerable from the built graph

features.name: Obsidian Research Memory
features.description: Generate/sync an Obsidian-compatible vault (Papers/Authors/Concepts/Claims/.../Maps) by script (never hand-written LLM links) plus research/memory/current-context.md and friends.
acceptance_criteria: vault sync is idempotent and derives links only from resolved data
current-context.md answers all required context questions

features.name: Experiment Scaffolder
features.description: experiment init <name> scaffolds README/hypothesis/protocol/environment/src/scripts/datasets/raw/results/analysis/figures/logs/manifest.yaml matching the experiment manifest schema.
acceptance_criteria: experiment init creates the full structure with a valid manifest.yaml
reproduction command recorded is the literal command needed to reproduce the run

features.name: LaTeX / Venue Scaffolder
features.description: latex-scaffolder + venue registry: paper init --venue <v> --name <n> scaffolds an academic LaTeX project against a registered, provenance-tracked venue template, never inventing formatting requirements.
acceptance_criteria: paper init fails clearly (not fabricated) for an unregistered venue
generated project builds with the scaffolded Makefile or reports LATEX MISSING

features.name: Multimodal Artifacts
features.description: Treat figures/tables as first-class persisted entities (png + json sidecar + analysis.md); record explicit CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE delegation tasks instead of silently skipping analysis.
acceptance_criteria: every extracted figure/table has both the human file and structured JSON sidecar
a capability gap creates a recorded delegation task, never a silent skip

features.name: Cross-Agent Handoff
features.description: handoff create / resume: persist enough state in .agent/state/handoff.{md,json} that a different agent/model resumes without chat history.
acceptance_criteria: handoff create -> fresh process -> resume reconstructs objective/current task/open questions/next steps
handoff.md and handoff.json never diverge on shared facts

features.name: Research Lineage
features.description: Maintain the Question -> Search -> Papers -> Claims -> Hypothesis -> Experiment -> Evidence -> Result -> Paper Section lineage chain so any claim's origin is reconstructable, distinguishing SOURCE FACT / AGENT INTERPRETATION / RESEARCHER DECISION.
acceptance_criteria: a paper-section claim's lineage can be walked backward to its originating evidence and resolved paper
no lineage node mixes SOURCE FACT with AGENT INTERPRETATION in the same field

features.name: Doctor / Validation / Observability
features.description: research-helper doctor + validate, JSONL observability logs, global config/cache resolution, and cross-platform bootstrap scripts (bootstrap.py/.sh/.ps1).
acceptance_criteria: doctor runs on macOS and reports accurate detection
validate fails loudly with an itemized report on deliberately broken fixtures
no log line contains a secret value
global config path resolution implemented for all four OS branches (unit-tested via mocked sys.platform where not natively runnable)

traceability.requirement: Scientific search: normalized schema, dedup, reproducible manifest (FR-001..FR-006)
Paper import with stable identifier + provenance (FR-001..FR-005)
Reference resolution against independent sources, consistency flags, BibTeX (FR-001..FR-007)
Open Access acquisition with legal-priority download + cache (FR-001..FR-007)
Three-level citation validation, UNVERIFIED precedes SUSPECTED_INVALID (FR-001..FR-006)
